blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Commission on Human Rights (CHR) is calling for stronger regional efforts to protect civilians and deliver humanitarian aid in Myanmar, with the Philippines serving as chair of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) this year. The appeal came as the Philippine rights body renewed its concern over the worsening humanitarian and human rights situation in Myanmar, more than five years after the military coup in February 2021. The CHR said armed conflict, attacks affecting civilians, displacement and restrictions on fundamental freedoms continue to threaten communities in the country.
